query: I need a budget hotel in New York that is clean and safe, without cockroaches, roaches, or dirty bathrooms.
gold_evidence: 217627 reviews say the bathroom was brand new, clean and well lighted; the neighborhood was safe; rooms/bathrooms were really clean; one review says NO bedbugs.
violating_evidence: 121981 contains 'mildew and pubic hair' in the bathroom; 649058 contains cockroach complaints.

query: I need a Manhattan hotel with clean bathrooms, without mildew or pubic hair in the bathroom.
gold_evidence: 217627 reviews mention a brand new, clean bathroom and repeatedly describe the facility as clean.
violating_evidence: 121981 has a review saying the bathroom had lots of mildew and pubic hair.

query: I need a hotel for sleep that is quiet, without loud noise, door slamming, or noisy hallways.
gold_evidence: 247108 says traffic noise was not a major problem and that weekends are usually pretty quiet after staff controlled hallway running/jumping.
violating_evidence: 107856 says teenagers were noisy, slamming doors, running, and very loud; another review says the breakfast buffet was too loud and woke the guest.

query: I need a business hotel with reliable internet and WiFi, not a place where the Internet is down or the WiFi does not work.
adversarial_terms: not Internet down;WiFi does not work
gold_evidence: 247108 says WiFi in the room worked fine and the business center computers/printers worked.
violating_evidence: 107856 says the Internet was down; 675842 reports trouble connecting to the Internet that staff could not solve.

query: I need a business hotel with computers and printers that work, not one with computers not working or an occupied business center.
gold_evidence: 247108 says computers and printers in the business center all worked.
violating_evidence: 286988 says computers were not always working; 675842 says a family was using all three business-center computers when the guest needed one.

query: I need a clean hotel with no roaches or cockroaches, where the rooms are immaculate and spotless.
gold_evidence: 675842 reviews describe the public areas as immaculate, the room as very clean, and the rooms as SUPER clean.
violating_evidence: 107856 reports one of the biggest roaches the reviewer had ever seen; 649058 reports cockroaches every night and morning.

query: I need a spacious suite for a family, not a tiny, cramped, or very small room.
gold_evidence: 1200768 says the rooms are all suites with a living room and bedroom area and that there is no problem cramming five people in a room.
violating_evidence: 286988 says a one-bedroom unit felt cramped and the breakfast/common area was crowded; 217627 and 121981 repeatedly describe tiny or very small rooms.

query: I need helpful and polite hotel staff, not rude or unprofessional front desk service.
gold_evidence: 2154898 reviews describe amazing service, accommodating staff, extraordinary care, and staff who treat guests very well.
violating_evidence: 1200768 says the front staff was not very friendly or helpful and another review says staff were rude about late checkout; 107856 describes curt/security/front-desk problems.

query: I need a hotel with free breakfast included, not one that charges ten dollars or has a breakfast surcharge.
gold_evidence: 91577 reviews mention free hot breakfast and adequate/free full breakfast.
violating_evidence: 247108 says breakfast was offered for a surcharge; 1200768 says breakfast cost about $10 per person.

query: I need a hotel with free parking, not an expensive parking charge or high daily parking fee.
adversarial_terms: not expensive parking charge;daily parking fee
gold_evidence: 247108 says complimentary WiFi, coffee, and parking were included in the price.
violating_evidence: 91577 mentions a $17 parking charge; 2154898 mentions parking is $35 per day.

query: I need a clean modern business hotel with good maintenance, not broken shower doors, sharp furniture, or shabby construction.
gold_evidence: 247108 reviews describe the hotel as new, clean, well-cared-for, and suitable for business travel.
violating_evidence: 675842 reports broken, dangerously sharp shower doors, sharp night-table corners, and shabby construction.

query: I need a hotel with a good breakfast, not a limited or awful breakfast experience.
gold_evidence: 286988 reviews call the breakfast excellent and one of the best motel breakfasts, with many hot and cold options.
violating_evidence: 107856 says the breakfast was very limited and awful; 121981 notes no hotel breakfast or limited breakfast context.

query: I need a clean affordable Manhattan hotel without shared-bathroom problems, dirty shared bathrooms, or long waits for bathrooms.
adversarial_terms: without shared-bathroom problems;dirty shared bathrooms;long waits
gold_evidence: 217627 says bathrooms were clean, and one review says shared bathrooms had four on the floor with no problems getting into one.
violating_evidence: 121981 discusses shared bathrooms plus mildew/pubic hair; 649058 has shared-bathroom and no-hot-water complaints.

query: I need a hotel with fast, stable WiFi in the room, not spotty WiFi or no wireless internet.
gold_evidence: 247108 says WiFi in the room worked fine.
violating_evidence: 91577 mentions spotty Wi-Fi service; 286988 mentions no wireless internet.

query: I need a hotel with friendly service, not security staring into my room or curt front desk behavior.
gold_evidence: 2154898 reviews emphasize amazing service, personal attention, courteous concierge staff, and conscientious employees.
violating_evidence: 107856 describes a security person staring into the room and acting curtly, along with front-desk frustration.

query: I need a quiet place for a weekend, not a hotel full of teenagers, slamming doors, or loud parents in hallways.
gold_evidence: 247108 says weekends are usually pretty quiet and that staff stopped hallway running and jumping during a tournament stay.
violating_evidence: 107856 reports teenagers on the floor being noisy, slamming doors, running, and very loud.

query: I need a hotel with a spacious dining or breakfast area, not a cramped and crowded breakfast area.
gold_evidence: 1200768 says the breakfast was very good and the dining area was spacious.
violating_evidence: 286988 says the common breakfast area in the lobby was cramped and crowded.

query: I need a hotel with working facilities and no broken room fixtures or low-quality shower doors.
gold_evidence: 247108 describes a very nice, well-cared-for property and working business-center facilities.
violating_evidence: 675842 reports broken, low-quality sliding glass shower doors that were coming apart.

query: I need a clean hotel without filthy tables, dirty bathrooms, or pubic hair.
gold_evidence: 675842 reviews repeatedly describe rooms/public areas as clean, SUPER clean, immaculate, and modern.
violating_evidence: 121981 reports mildew and pubic hair in bathrooms; 1200768 reports filthy breakfast tables.

query: I need a hotel with airport shuttle service, not a place where airport transportation fails or the arranged car service does not show up.
adversarial_terms: transportation fails;car service does not show up
gold_evidence: 675842 says the shuttle from the airport was very quick and the drivers were excellent both ways.
violating_evidence: 2154898 says the car service arranged by the hotel did not show up and the guests waited around at LAX for an hour.
